attempts.summary: Built a WireGuard site-to-site tunnel between node1 and node2 over the transit network (10.0.0.1/10.0.0.2), routing the private subnets lan-a (192.168.10.0/24, node1↔node3) and lan-b (192.168.20.0/24, node2↔node4) across it via wg0 (10.200.0.1/10.200.0.2), so node3 and node4 reach each other by private address with traffic encrypted end-to-end over the transit link. Verified via tcpdump that only encrypted UDP/51820 traffic crosses the transit wire, no plaintext ICMP. Completed the mandatory restart protocol: restarted all four nodes one at a time, confirmed changed boot IDs, and verified full tunnel/routing/connectivity recovery after each restart.
